page_title: CEL 0-0 RAY | Celta Vigo v Rayo Vallecano 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the crossbar. Good effort!
90+6' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+4' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar.
90+3' This will be a very dangerous free kick from just outside the box and it's a very promising distance, indeed. Let's see what Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) will come up with.
90+2' PENALTY APPEAL after Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
89' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
88' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
88' The ball is cleared after Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
87' Substitution. Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) on for Hugo Alvarez.
87' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
86' Celta Vigo couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) leaped high and intercepted a cross.

85' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Celta Vigo are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
84' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
83' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
81' Here is a change. Isi Palazon is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano).
81' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Jose Pozo (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Oscar Valentin.
79' Iago Aspas delivers a perfect cross for Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.
77' Substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) replaces Jorgen Strand Larsen.
77' The cross fools the defence and leaves Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just over the bar.
75' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) plays a through ball but overhits it.
72' The referee is firm and issues Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) a deserved yellow card.
72' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
69' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
67' The Jailson (Celta Vigo) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Alejandro Hernandez rules it out for a foul.
66' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Jonathan Bamba is replaced by Carles Perez (Celta Vigo).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Sergio Camello cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' Substitution. Jailson (Celta Vigo) has come on for Hugo Sotelo.
62' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
60' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
60' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) heads on.
58' The free kick is delivered by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
56' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
56' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

50' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Vicente Guaita easily catches the ball.
49' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
48' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
46' Inigo Perez makes a half-time substitution. Alfonso Espino comes on in place of Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) is replaced by Renato Tapia.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Alejandro Hernandez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
45+2' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' This is a yellow card! Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
44' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
43' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
41' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
39' The game is interrupted now, Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is flagged for offside.
37' Stole Dimitrievski makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) after a cross from the side.
37' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
36' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Celta Vigo have a corner.
35' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Vicente Guaita.
34' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Hernandez signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
33' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
30' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.

29' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.
28' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
26' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
24' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
23' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
23' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
22' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

21' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
20' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.

19' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
18' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
16' Alvaro Garcia is substituted due to injury. Inigo Perez gives a chance to Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano).

15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
13' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
10' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picks up a long through ball, but Stole Dimitrievski deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
9' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
7' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
5' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

4' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Stole Dimitrievski. Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
1' The referee blows his whistle as Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick to Celta Vigo.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will officiate today.
